answer: Ridge fixed-pool dilution bond: each identity locks 70 credits in the ridge pool and files one claim. The pool dilutes shares on a pulse rhythm; each epoch a falcon auditor recomputes shares, and any delta between claimed and recomputed share burns the bond. First fake 40, k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented rings fail: one ridge pulse phase cannot serve two claims; honest agents pay 40 once.
